messages.body: I don't know how to file a consumer complaint. The clearance GoPro Hero from order O-60123 arrived broken. I know it was final sale but it doesn't work.

text: category returns_refunds: Need guidance on returning a damaged GoPro Hero from order O-60123 and obtaining a refund.
Policy lookup needed to determine returns/refund path for a damaged final-sale item.

args: {"k":3,"query":"Returns and refunds policy for damaged or defective items, especially final-sale items; procedures for consumer complaints and refunds for order O-60123."}

passages.title: Damaged or incorrect items
passages.text:
POL-RET-05 v1.1: Damaged or incorrect items
Conditions: The report identifies an owned order and affected item. The delivery record is consistent with the report and the first report is within 30 calendar days of delivery. Staff approval for the specific damage or wrong-item remedy is required. A report alone is not permission to execute a refund.
Rules: Qualifying damaged or incorrect items are eligible for a refund or replacement after staff approval, including final-sale items. Customers do not pay return shipping for this remedy. When the order and report are consistent and only staff authorization for an exact refund remains, use awaiting_approval. Staff approval must record the damage or wrong-item basis; a generic approval unrelated to this claim is insufficient. The staff-approved remedy may waive a physical return. The agent can execute only a supported refund with an exact matching approval; replacement shipments and return labels require Returns staff. Ask for missing item or damage details. Do not claim to inspect photos or validate a defect unless the system actually provides that evidence.
Exceptions: If the item is final sale, retrieve POL-RET-04 too. Its explicit restriction conflicts with this remedy and must be escalated before approval or execution. Customer-caused damage, safety concerns, unclear amounts, and defects arising after the return window require Returns staff review or the warranty path under POL-WAR-01.

passages.title: Standard returns and gift returns
passages.text:
POL-RET-01 v1.1: Standard returns and gift returns
Conditions: Standard items may be returned within 30 calendar days of shipment.delivered_at, including day 30. Use the first recorded return request or dispatch date; a received return within that window also establishes timeliness. A standard refund requires a stored return.received_at and return.condition=like_new. An earlier return request remains valid on resume; do not restart its window.
Rules: For an eligible unreturned item, ask the customer to return the complete item in its original packaging through the store return process and retain tracking. The customer pays change-of-mind return shipping. Do not invent a warehouse address or claim to issue a return label. Use awaiting_customer while the necessary customer return action or order details are missing. If the customer has already completed their part and staff receipt verification is pending, escalate for staff review. After timely receipt in like-new condition, refund eligibility is established; exact approval and balance checks still apply under POL-RET-02. Gift recipients may return items for store credit within 30 days, including items marked final sale. Ownership or gift entitlement must be verified by staff. Issuing store credit is a staff action, not an agent tool.
Exceptions: Ordinary final-sale returns are excluded under POL-RET-04. The gift-return clause expressly includes final-sale items; if that policy disagrees, follow the conflict process in POL-SUP-01. For a change-of-mind request after day 30, explain that the return window has passed and escalate any exception request to Returns staff; do not decline it as final. Missing condition evidence also goes to Returns staff. A defect may have a separate damage or warranty path.

passages.title: Final sale restrictions
passages.text:
POL-RET-04 v1.1: Final sale restrictions
Conditions: Use the explicit final_sale flag or verified purchase terms. A reduced price alone does not establish final-sale status. An omitted final_sale flag means the item is not marked final sale.
Rules: Final-sale products cannot be returned for cash refunds, exchanges, or store credit. This restriction includes gifts, damaged arrivals, incorrect items, and reported manufacturing defects. Final-sale products are also excluded from the store-facilitated warranty remedy. Under this policy, no merchandise remedy is available for those items. result.response:
Thanks for letting us know about the damaged GoPro on order O-60123. Because the item is marked final sale, refunds aren’t issued automatically; damage or incorrect-item remedies require staff approval. I’m escalating your case to our Returns team for an official determination. To help speed this up, please reply with:
- Clear photos of the damage showing the item and its packaging
- Confirmation that you have the original packaging and all accessories
- A brief description of how the item arrived and what isn’t functioning

We’ll update you as soon as the Returns team has reviewed and let you know the available remedy, if any, and whether a return label or replacement is needed. Thank you for your patience.
